text.brief: In March 1941 Wang Zhen marched the 359th Brigade into the valley of Nanniwan to reclaim wasteland, the start of a production drive the Party still celebrates in song.
text.record: The Party's border region grew poppy under the euphemism of a special product, bought the harvest through its own agencies and sold the opium into Nationalist-held territory. It banned opium use inside its own areas. Senior leaders argued over the policy in writing, as Xie Juezai's diary published in China records.
text.reading: Chen Yung-fa's archival study puts the trade near forty percent of the border region's revenue in the war years, a finding from research through the records rather than an admission. The Party banned the drug at home and sold it outside, the same asymmetry its platforms run today between Douyin and TikTok.
text.gapText: Data Architecture. The trade's revenue share rests on archival research because the Party has never published its accounts.
text.fix: Demand audited accounts from any party or state that asks for trust, and treat their absence as a finding.
